INDICATIONS

Dr.Reckeweg R131- Liver Tonic boost your Liver health naturally with a holistic approach that supports overall well-being. This natural remedy activates the liver, keeping it healthy and functioning efficiently. It is particularly beneficial for conditions such as fatty liver, hepatitis, jaundice, and an enlarged liver. Additionally, it helps combat physical weakness and fatigue while improving digestion and appetite, and relieving common issues like gas and acidity. By aiding in the elimination of toxins from the body, it also provides essential support for those dealing with liver side effects related to alcohol and drug use.

 

MODE OF ACTION OF MAIN INGREDIENTS:

Carduus Marianus is a primary liver remedy known for its effectiveness in liver congestion, fatty liver, hepatitis, jaundice etc. It supports bile flow and overall detoxification of the liver.

Chimaphilla umbellata  assists in hepatic detox, making it useful when liver dysfunction is linked with urinary complaints.

Juglans acts on both the liver and skin, helping cleanse the liver when impurities manifest through skin issues like eczema or boils.

Phaseolus nanus is mainly used to address liver-related fatigue and weakness, especially in diabetic by supporting overall hepatic function.

Quassia  enhances liver and digestive secretions, proving beneficial in indigestion, gas, and loss of appetite linked with sluggish liver activity.

Sarsaparilla is helpful in eliminating toxins from the liver and is often indicated when liver dysfunction leads to skin eruptions or urinary symptoms.

Scilla supports the liver in chronic congestion cases and helps manage fluid retention, such as ascites, due to liver disorders.

Taraxacum is excellent for treating a sluggish liver, jaundice, coated tongue, bitter taste in the mouth, and digestive disturbances. It promotes bile secretion and helps relieve liver-related headaches and digestive discomfort.

 

DOSAGE

Adults 1 tablespoon, Children 1 teaspoon thrice a day before meals, unless prescribed otherwise.

REMARKS
Recommended to use along with R7 drops which focuses on detoxification, liver inflammation and gallbladder support , whereas R131 acts as a general liver tonic and digestive stimulant which overall activates the liver, keeping it healthy and functioning efficiently.
In inflammatory diseases of liver and biliary vesicle, use additionally R1 drops 10-15 drops three times a day.
In gastric diseases like gastritis, peptic ulcer use additionally R5 drops 10-15 drops three times a day.
